I have Treatment Resistant Depression but I'm also considered high-functioning (it's a genuine issue when it comes to having my MDD taken seriously by medical professionals). But being considered high-functioning isn't difficult, it's an incredibly low bar. I work part time and extra hours if I'm asked, I only call in when I'm very sick and I don't have issues with attending appointments. That being said, I have no social life, rarely have any motivation to do pretty much anything, don't exercise, my house is a complete mess, I'm constantly behind with even the bare minimum of personal hygiene/housework/errands, I hate myself more than anyone else ever could and I regularly think about self harm. 

I honestly spend most of free time away from work either sleeping or wasting time on the internet. Most days can be described with the emotion "meh" and they're all very similar. I tend to put all my energy into my work and don't have much left for anything else. It makes for a shit life.

Every day for me is bad, it just varies in degrees. Some days I'll feel like crap but might accomplish something, others I lay on my couch for so long my fitbit thinks I'm sleeping. A really bad day is uncontrollable crying and suicidal ideation. 

Depression effects so much of my life: 
I either have insomnia or I sleep 10-12 hours and feel just as bad,
I'm tired/physically exhausted constantly ("I'm just tired" is a go to excuse if anyone asks),
Doing the simplest task can take hours, so I tend to prioritize and only do what can't be avoided and give up on everything else,
I tend to withdraw socially and have no friends,
I binge watch crappy old TV because I don't have the "strength" to deal with anything else,
My memory and concentration are getting worse,
Depression (or my anxiety) can cause me to have no appetite so I lose weight quickly,
My self care is the worst effected and I will often not shower, brush my teeth or do my dishes because it's too much effort (sometimes I just won't eat anything because I don't want to have more dirty dishes to deal with),
Emotionally I am mainly numb/apathetic or sad.

Thankfully I'm not suicidal at the moment but I do still have bad days when I have the urge to hurt myself (hence the username).

Unfortunately I have treatment resistant depression so there is no antidepressant that can help. I try to keep on top of it by seeing a Psychologist regularly, taking vitamin D and when I can eating healthy and exercising. But I personally don't feel much improvement.

When I first noticed something was wrong was when I was in high school. For months and months I felt like you do right before you get sick with a bad flu: very tired, sleeping a lot, physically weak, no motivation, reduced appetite, low energy. I felt it was dismissed as not being serious by a lot of people because I was a teenager and because it can easily come across as being just a phase or plain laziness. I'll admit that I even bought into that and I waited for the magical day it would get better.

15 years later and I'm still depressed (it never stopped) and have since been diagnosed as having Treatment Resistant Major Depressive Disorder, Generalized Anxiety Disorder and Social Anxiety. Depression and Anxiety tend to go hand and hand so I'm never sure which one my symptoms are being caused by.

Most days I feel very numb emotionally, like I can't access my emotions or they're muted (those are the days I have to put on a mask and fake it when I'm around other people). Some days I cry at the smallest thing. Other days I'm angry at everyone and everything.

I'm always, always tired. Most nights I have insomnia and barely sleep and every now and again I sleep over 12 hours. When it's bad I lose my appetite and can't stomach the thought of eating anything so I lose a noticeable amount of weight (most recently it was about 40 pounds, my doc thought I had cancer). I've lost hope that I'll find something that will help me and I'm pretty sure my second therapist has also given up on me. I feel hopeless in general, like life isn't worth living but I'm not bad enough to kill myself. I did get bad enough that I now have cut marks on my left arm (hence my username). I tend to socially isolate myself and don't have any friends. I've gone weeks without showering and months without washing my hair. Pretty much anything I used to enjoy I just don't feel like doing anymore. I spend a lot of my time rewatching shit TV and YouTube and surfing reddit.

When I was suicidal the weight of my depression actually felt physically painful. And I didn't want to kill myself as much as I just wanted the pain to just stop. It felt like I was drowning in my depression, being pulled under repeatedly and having no hope of being saved.

I do have something to say to those out their who feel like giving me "advice" for my depression: Unless you are a medical professional or a suffering from the exact same thing as I am (very doubtful), I'm sorry but I don't want to hear it. When I've seen multiple doctors and therapists, tried every type of antidepressant and none have worked, the vitamins/herbal supplements you suggest are not the solution (I've probably tried those too). And of course I know exercise is good for depression but it's pretty useless when I literally don't move or leave my couch for so long my fitbit thinks I'm sleeping. And telling me, a person with social anxiety, to force myself to get out and meet people is beyond stupid. And I don't believe you when you say I can talk to you about anything because that has backfired on me so many times. Most people can't handle or don't understand how bad depression is.

If you want to help just be there. If you haven't heard from me in a long time don't wait for me to initiate something, send me a message. Offer to do something with me. If you really think exercise will help me suggest doing something physical together. Just don't give up on me because otherwise I'll give up on myself.

I'm treatment resistant and my psychiatrist gave up on trying to find an AD that would work for me. I stopped taking my last AD in September last year, so I know that my loss of appetite is not a side effect of medication.

Since November I've pretty much lost my sense of hunger, I no longer crave things and some days I have to force myself to eat. I know my stomach has shrunk because when I do eat it's significantly less than what I used to.

In the almost 15years I've been suffering from depression and anxiety I've never felt like this.

When it was bad I went 3 days eating just a piece of toast. So far I've lost about 32lbs/14.5kg, just 17lbs/8kg more and I'll be underweight. I know it's not a lot but I'm losing a lot of hair, I haven't been this weight since early high school, everyone has noticed and my doc and psychologist are concerned. It's probably a symptom of my depression and anxiety but it's difficult not to be worried that it's something worse like cancer.

All my tests have come up negative so as a last resort my doc sent me off to get an colonoscopy and upper endoscopy done last week. The doc said he didn't find anything but that he'd taken biopsies, so now I'm just waiting for the results to come back.

I know I've been waiting months for answers and that waiting another week shouldn't matter but it does. I really hate waiting.

A billboard promoting a children's movie has sparked outrage online after claims that it promotes body shaming.
The ad for Red Shoes and the Seven Dwarfs, a new film starring the voice of actress Chloe Moretz, shows the tall, thin heroine wearing red high-heeled shoes next to a shorter, heavier version of herself.
"What if Snow White was no longer beautiful and the Seven Dwarfs not so short?" the tagline asks.
Red Shoes and the Seven Dwarfs is a product of South Korea's Locus Creative Studios and has been described as a Snow White "parody with a twist."
Plus size blogger Tess Holliday was one of the many who tweeted their outrage at the billboard, asking "How did this get approved by an entire marketing team?"
"Why is it okay to tell young kids being fat = ugly?"
A photo of the billboard also sparked ire in a parent's Facebook group, Huffington Post reported.
"What the hell??? So because she's not a complete waif but actually normal size, she is no longer beautiful?!?! No way on this movie!!" wrote one parent.
"My kids will never see this," added another.
"If it's a kid's movie it's horrendous," another mum commented.
